teamsAppDefinition.shortDescription: OneNote: Digital notes to help you be productive & collaborate with your team.
teamsAppDefinition.description:
Microsoft OneNote is a versatile digital notebook designed to meet all your notetaking requirements.
Here are some key features:
- Free-form writing and drawing: Whether you prefer typing, writing, or drawing, OneNote provides a free-form experience akin to pen and paper.
- Collaboration made easy: Share your notebooks with others, allowing simultaneous viewing and contribution. Collaborate seamlessly with colleagues, classmates, or friends.
- Dictation for precision: Never overlook details with voice dictation. Capture your thoughts efficiently, focus on essential content, and revisit it later.
- Cross-device accessibility: Access your notebooks from any device—whether you’re at work, home, school, or on the move.
Ready to organize your thoughts? Explore Microsoft OneNote and sign up [here](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/onenote/digital-note-taking-app).

teamsAppDefinition.shortDescription: A hub for all your content
teamsAppDefinition.description:
This app helps discovering, accessing and sharing your files from your chats, channels or meetings in Teams. The app experience is also consistent and familiar with how files are stored, shared and accessed across Microsoft 365 and OneDrive. The app offers easy navigation to relevant files and offers following navigation functionality:
•    Home: Get back to your recently accessed files.
•    My files: Access your personal files saved in your OneDrive. 
•    Shared: Find files shared with you and files you have shared with others across Microsoft 365.
•    Downloads: Locate files downloaded from Teams on your computer.
•    Quick Access: Pin a Teams channel file tab or SharePoint document library to access quickly.

[Get Help](https://support.microsoft.com/forms)

teamsAppDefinition.shortDescription: Outgoing Webhooks help communicate with apps outside Microsoft Teams.
teamsAppDefinition.description: Webhooks are a great way for Teams to integrate with external apps. A webhook is essentially a POST request sent to a callback URL. In Teams, outgoing webhooks provide a simple way to allow users to send messages to your web service without having to go through the full process of creating bots via the Microsoft Bot Framework. Outgoing webhooks post data from Teams to any chosen service capable of accepting a JSON payload. Once an outgoing webhook is added to a team, it acts like bot, listening in channels for messages using @mention, sending notifications to external web services, and responding with rich messages that can include cards and images.

teamsAppDefinition.description:
The new Microsoft Planner brings together the best of To Do, Planner, and Project for the web with the added intelligence of Copilot.

**Simple**
Easily manage all your tasks, to-dos, lists, plans, and projects across Microsoft 365 apps.

**Flexible**
From individual task management to large team initiatives, Planner scales to meet your organization's changing needs. Use templates to quickly start a new plan and choose between views such as lists, boards, timelines, and goals.

**Intelligent**
Accelerate outcomes with AI. Copilot in Planner (preview) can help you and your team generate new plans, set goals, track status, and react to changes as projects evolve.
